purpose: Registry records admitted through validation:add before that tool required a real risk statement. Each carries a tool-written placeholder in risk_prevented - the field a human reads to learn what a HARD_FAIL gate is for, and the field audit_governance_blockers.mjs reads when proposing a severity migration. This list is a RATCHET, not an exemption.
rules: A record NOT on this list carrying a placeholder is a FAIL: new protection must explain itself.
The list growing past ceiling is a FAIL.
An id on this list whose risk_prevented has since been written properly is a FAIL until it is removed and ceiling is lowered, so the list cannot go stale and quietly re-authorise a placeholder.
An id on this list that is no longer in the registry is a FAIL, so retirement does not leave the ratchet holding slack.
evidence: VAL-EXTRACTION-SURFACE-GUARD-SNAPSHOT and VAL-EXTRACTION-SURFACE-GUARD-CHECK were on this list when it was first derived at 55 entries. They are the HARD_FAIL gate behind Validate Repo runs 33515334720 (1,628 drifted surfaces) and 33727145801 (230 changed surfaces), and downstream of the first, Main Validation Sentinel alarm 33533720679. Both were written properly and removed, lowering the ceiling to 53.
